models.title: Review · words 1–20 · one easy question each

block.label: REVIEW · WORDS 1–20 · ONE QUESTION EACH
block.html: Answer with the word on the card.

cats.name: Words 1–10
qs: What new product did a company unveil this year? [try: unveiled]
Was your last flight or bus delayed? What happened? [try: was delayed]
Did you ever pay a deposit for something? What was it? [try: a deposit]
Do you have a deadline this week? For what? [try: deadline]
Which movie or series had a lot of hype, but wasn't good? [try: hype]
Do you like being in the spotlight? Why or why not? [try: the spotlight]
What was the last thing you bought that was worth it? [try: worth it]
Did anyone ever break into your car or your house? [try: broke into]
What is priceless to you? [try: priceless]
What melts very fast in the summer? [try: melts]

cats.name: Words 11–20
qs: Who do you suspect eats the chocolate in your house? [try: I suspect]
Did you ever make a deal with a friend or your boss? [try: a deal]
Is your car dented anywhere? How did it happen? [try: dented]
What is always missing in your house? [try: missing]
In your favorite crime movie or series, who ends up behind bars? [try: behind bars]
What do you give your friends in exchange for a favor? [try: in exchange for]
What can't you afford right now? [try: can't afford]
What did you run out of at home this week? [try: ran out of]
What do you want to get rid of in your house? [try: get rid of]
What are you looking forward to this month? [try: looking forward to]

lesson.title: 40 Words, Part 2
lesson.subtitle: Review of words 1–20 · new words 21–40
lesson.plan: Feedback da aula 27: "vimos até a palavra 20, continuar as próximas". 1) Revisão: uma pergunta fácil para cada palavra de 1 a 20 (a palavra está no cartão). 2) A caixa de ferramentas (conectores e who / which / where). 3) As palavras 21 a 40, com os mixers e os jogos finais, que ficaram pendentes na aula 27. As pendências da aula 26 continuam na ficha.
